verification.method: sh_kin (numpy) vs crab_hex_linkage (torch, float64) on a 211 x 136 hip x knee grid over the USD ROM; central finite differences (eps 1e-6 rad) of the rod-length functions; the coupled conversion checked by virtual work (tau.dtheta = F.dL) on 2000 random states; the action layer (parkour_actions.py:345-376 arithmetic through the torch linkage) on a 97 x 97 grid of raw actions in +-4.8

anchor.mapping: h_model = h - H_OFFSET, H_OFFSET = 1.064 - h_geom(defaults) = -0.00094 m (tilted-pad rigid model: toe centre + the footpad box's lowest corner, the pad tilting with the tibia; 1.0649 m at a = 0). The flat-pad reading (pad bottom a constant 0.02 m below the toe centre) gives 1.0561 m at a = 0, i.e. offset +0.0079 m; it drifts with the tibia tilt (pad drop 0.0236 m at 0.69 m to 0.0288 m at 1.064), the tilted-pad offset is the one held constant.

a_posture.method: q(h): fixed-point / closed-form two-link IK of the leg-plane chain (pivot (0.0635, -0.2413), femur 0.5842, tibia 0.8255) for toe centre (U0, -(h - H_OFFSET - pad_drop)), the knee-outboard branch; a_hip = (theta_h - default)/0.25; a_knee_left = (knee angle that gives the solved knee ROD at the DEFAULT hip - knee default)/0.25 (parkour_actions.py:364-376: the knee action is a rod length read at the default hip and re-solved at the hip target); right legs' policy knee = -a_knee_left. Feet on a flat floor, body level, cams 0, rigid joints (the PD sag is inside the constant anchor).
a_posture.h_kinematic_floor_rule: stance hip at the -45 deg USD stop at constant reach U0

h_min.rule: h_min = max(kinematic floor at constant reach + 0.02 m, lowest h whose stance hip keeps >= 0.125 rad (|R lift| 0.5 x 0.25) above the -45 deg stop); frozen = ceil to 1 mm

action_limits.note: hip: target = default + 0.25 a -> stop / rod-window angles map 1:1; knee: the action is a rod length read at the DEFAULT hip, so the knee rod window maps to fixed knee actions, while a knee joint stop is a different action at every hip (the 'at_default_hip' values only)

q_table_5mm.note: linear interpolation in this table reproduces sh_kin.q to < 1e-4 action units; 1.064 is a node (q exactly 0); the build may call sh_kin.q directly

a_posture.restep_clearance_method: body held, stance leg at q(h) (target angles) commanded q + (-0.5, 0) (hip-only lift, knee rod command held) and q + (-0.5, +0.5) (R's D3 LIFT: knee = -rho*side*hip, rho 1, = +0.5 left-convention); rise of the footpad's lowest corner

b_forces.rows_rule: settled stand rows: p2r_stand_mode (latched stand slot) held > 2.0 s, all 12 rods still (|rod_speed| < 1e-06), all hip-pitch / knee |joint_vel| < 0.05 rad/s, >= 5 feet with net contact > 50.0 N, not done; joints picked by run_meta.joint_names (*_Hip_Femur_RevoluteJoint, *_Femur_Tibia_RevoluteJoint); right-leg knee angle and torque multiplied by -1 into the left convention; applied_torque = the implicit PD's k (q_target - q) + d (qd_target - qd) (Isaac Lab ImplicitActuator estimate; static rows)
b_forces.conversion: COUPLED: [tau_h, tau_k] = J^T [F_h, F_k], J = [[dLh/dth, 0], [dLk/dth, dLk/dtk]] at the measured joint angles, i.e. F_k = tau_k / (dLk/dtk), F_h = (tau_h - (dLk/dth) F_k) / (dLh/dth); + = rod pushes (extends), - = rod pulls. Sign conventions: dLh/dth > 0 and dLk/dtk > 0 over the whole ROM (the linkage module's moment arms are their absolute values; the action term's velocity feedforward omega_k = (dL_k/dt - coupling omega_h)/ma_k uses the same signs), dLk/dth = knee_hip_coupling, signed, > 0 over the stance range; all three equal central finite differences of the rod-length functions (verification block).
b_forces.statistic: six-leg mean of |F_hip| per row, averaged over rows (the user's cap statistic); worst leg = the leg with the largest per-leg mean |F|; knee reported, hold-only (non-backdrivable), not capped

exploration_reference_at_1p064.method: even 6-way share of the whole robot weight (230.06 kg x 9.81 / 6 = 376.1 N per toe, vertical, at the toe centre), q(1.064) = default angles, virtual work + the coupled conversion; reproduces the exploration's 1784 N / 1424 N

scale_factors.rule: scale = pooled measured six-leg mean |F| / the model's |F| at the measured mean posture (per stamp, pooled), applied as a constant factor to the model curve

b_forces.h_max_rule: highest h on a 1 mm grid whose modelled six-leg mean |F_hip| <= 2000.0 N

excess_hip_torque_diagnostic.hip_rod_force_structure: F_hip = (tau_h - c F_k)/a = (tau_h - (c/b) tau_k)/a with c/b = 0.890 at the default pose: F_hip tracks the (near-)invariant tau_h - tau_k, so it does NOT depend on how the stance's internal horizontal forces split the load between hip and knee (A-mask and R differ in that split by ~27 N*m but agree on F_hip within 1.5 %); the knee rod force does depend on it
excess_hip_torque_diagnostic.reading: Per leg, the measured torques regressed on the measured foot load: hip slope 0.533 m vs a geometric lever 0.309 m, knee slope -0.181 vs -0.275 m. The hip/knee SPLIT differs by controller (R: more hip, less knee) as an in-plane horizontal stance force would make it, but tau_hip - tau_knee is the same for both controllers ({'SN_Amask_s17': [246.8, 246.8], 'R_P2R_RSTg_s18': [246.7, 246.9]} N*m) and is 12 % / 22 % above the model (no / with leg weight: 219.7 / 201.7 N*m); per unit foot load the slope sum is 0.714 m vs the 0.584 m that ANY foot force must give. The four stamps agree on tau_hip - tau_knee to 0.2 N*m (it is fixed by the total weight: the six-leg mean knee-point load x Lf cos th), so the excess (~45 N*m per leg, ~ +12 % of the weight-only value, +22 % with leg weight) is not a foot force the static model omits and not noise: either the sim's implicit-PD torque reading (Isaac Lab's k (q_target - q) estimate) differs from the joints' true loads, or a load path outside the leg-plane statics exists. Which joint carries it cannot be separated from the split; the hip ROD force tracks the sum (see hip_rod_force_structure), so the whole excess lands on F_hip. Unexplained on CPU; needs a Kit-side check (e.g. the articulation's measured joint reaction forces vs applied_torque on a settled stand) before the measured hip number is trusted as a force.

Evaluated on a 9 x 9 grid.
random_fold_family.rule_for_tables: on a table of top t, draw a random fold only if its table_top_min <= t (legs >= 0.02 m above the floor); otherwise it is a floor-touching start

table_range.rule: spawn root z = top + 0.15875 (belly) + 0.005; top_min = every leg part of the retracted pose >= 0.02 m above the floor at spawn (knee_folded binds: its toes); legs clear the table laterally by the sn_table_core lateral clearance (the 0.90 x 0.70 m table, +-3 cm / +-10 deg jitter, is inside the leg yaw axes at |y| 0.6096; independent of the top height); top_max (training) = min(restore: belly at 1.064 - 0.15875 clears the top by >= 0.10 m, h_max - 0.264 so h_cmd >= top + 0.264 is reachable); K3 eval tops: >= 3 incl. 0.635 with top + 0.31 <= h_max
